title: Lizard on the Loose
description: A 3:05 stylized 3D punk-rock animated music video featuring a rebellious lime-green anthropomorphic lizard skateboarder and guitarist transforming the half-abandoned Rust Row neighborhood into his playground.

characters.name: The Lizard
characters.role: Protagonist; rebellious skateboarder and electric guitarist.
characters.appearance:
A cool, rebellious anthropomorphic lizard, lean wiry build, approximately 1.7 meters tall, with a loose confident slouch. Lime-green detailed reptile scales, pale yellow-green throat and belly, forest-green shadows, a row of short spines from brow to nape and down the tail.

Long reptile snout, big amber eyes with vertical slit pupils and heavy half-closed eyelids, wide crooked toothy grin, one chipped upper-left tooth, three cream stripes on the left cheek.

Faded mustard-yellow baseball cap worn backwards, with crest spines poking through the strap gap.

Oversized black hoodie with no logo, hood down, sleeves pushed to the elbows, frayed white drawstrings.

Baggy charcoal cargo pants with large thigh pockets, frayed hems, thick tail with dark bands near the tip exiting through a slit at the back.

Worn, scuffed off-white skate high-tops with neon-magenta laces.

Chunky black over-ear headphones with neon-green ring accents.

Five fingers with short blunt claws, capable of playing guitar naturally.
